content_sections.heading: IIMK Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. C-86/2026-IIMK.HR gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download IIMK notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Pass in Plus Two (12th std) or Equivalent & Two years of office experience (post qualification) Experience: Two years of office experience (post qualification) Age limit: Maximum 28 years Other conditions: Conversant with English and Hindi Desirable: Basic knowledge of Computer & MS Office Ability to work as part of a team, courteous and service-oriented attitude

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for IIMK Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, automatically disqualifies the candidate

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely on contract basis for an initial period of six months Further extensions subject to job requirements and performance

content_sections.heading: How Will IIMK Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening of applications and shortlisting based on details submitted Interview of shortlisted candidates Verification of certificates and experience at the time of joining Eligible applications will be screened and only shortlisted candidates will be interviewed Interview time slots will be communicated by e-mail Date and time of interview: to be announced Engagement subject to verification of all certificates and experience at the time of joining

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIMK Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit the application online at https://iimk.ac.in/ by 5:00 pm of 23.11.2026. Upload photograph, certificates, CV and signature as per the format prescribed in the online portal. After applying, check the website and email regularly for any change in the interview schedule.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applicants should visit the website and check emails regularly for any change in the interview schedule Decision of the Director, IIMK regarding the selection shall be final

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIMK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for IIMK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for IIMK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 18,000 consolidated per month plus Rs. 300 telephone allowance.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pass in Plus Two (12th std) or Equivalent & Two years of office experience (post qualification).

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Conversant with English and Hindi.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Canvassing in any form or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, automatically disqualifies the candidate.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening of applications and shortlisting based on details submitted. Interview of shortlisted candidates. Verification of certificates and experience at the time of joining. Eligible applications will be screened and only shortlisted candidates will be interviewed.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely on contract basis for an initial period of six months. Further extensions subject to job requirements and performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode, Kozhikode.
